topic: Microscope Parts, Functions, and Proper Handling
key_concepts: The eyepiece/ocular lens is where you look and typically magnifies 5x
The body tube connects the eyepiece to the objective lenses and maintains alignment
The revolving nosepiece holds and rotates the objective lenses
The low-power objective magnifies 10x; the high-power objective magnifies 40x
The stage and stage clips hold the slide in place
The mirror, iris diaphragm, and condenser control and focus light on the specimen
The coarse adjustment knob makes large focus changes; the fine adjustment knob makes preci
Microscope parts are classified as magnifying, illuminating, or mechanical
Carry the microscope with two hands and place it on a flat, stable surface
Store with the lowest objective in place, slide removed, covered, in a cool dry place
Clean lenses with a soft lint-free cloth; avoid touching lenses and never let the lens tou
Start focusing with low power and use fine focus at high magnification
